youtube.title: From the Army to working for drug runners: Jason, GTA 6
youtube.description: Rockstar says Jason grew up around grifters and crooks, so he joined the Army hoping to leave that life behind. Afterwards he worked for local drug runners in the Leonida Keys, and in trailer two he picks up Lucia the day she gets out of prison. GTA 6 is scheduled for November 19th, after two delays. Facts checked against Wikipedia (Grand Theft Auto VI) and search summaries of Rockstar's character text; no Rockstar page was readable.

tiktok.caption: From the Army to working for drug runners: that's Jason from GTA 6. Rockstar's bio, roughly: he wants an easy life, but it keeps getting harder. Scheduled for November 19th.
